[1munknown-phrase:[0m No phrase matches the sentence by its shape.

A sentence matches a phrase when it has the same number of items and the same words in the same places. A hole takes exactly one item, so a sentence of several words must be inside parentheses. If nothing matches, you get `unknown-phrase`. It is also the error for an event phrase that stands outside `when`, a record field that does not exist, and a `message … with` setting of more than two items.

A common cause is a missing pair of parentheses. Here `if` takes one condition, and `n.Role is "leader"` is three items.

[1mExample (p/p.synod):[0m
    # package p
    Node has
      set Role to "follower"

    define [n: Node] Demote
      if n.Role is "leader"
        set n.Role to "follower"

[1msynod check says:[0m
    p/p.synod:6:3: [1;31merror[unknown-phrase][0m: [1mno phrase matches "if n.Role is "leader""[0m
     [1;34m |[0m
    [1;34m6 |[0m   if n.Role is "leader"
     [1;34m |[0m   [1;31m^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^[0m [1;31mno phrase takes these items[0m
     [1;34m |[0m      [1;34m------------------[0m [1;34m3 items here; "if" takes one condition[0m
     [1;34m |[0m
    [1;36mhelp:[0m parenthesize the condition
     [1;34m |[0m
    [1;34m6 |[0m   if [32m([0mn.Role is "leader"[32m)[0m
     [1;34m |[0m      [32m+[0m                  [32m+[0m
     [1;34m |[0m

[1mFix:[0m Parenthesize the condition.
    # package p
    Node has
      set Role to "follower"

    define [n: Node] Demote
      if (n.Role is "leader")
        set n.Role to "follower"
